issues.detail: The Greek 'αντικατεστητε' (antikatesthete) means 'to resist' or 'to oppose' in a spiritual/combative sense. The Vietnamese 'chống trả' usually implies physical retaliation or fighting back against an active attack. While similar, the Greek context of 'competing/struggling' (ἀγωνιζομενοι) makes 'chống lại' or 'đấu tranh' more accurate than 'chống trả'.
